description: Works without a Gameye account or token. Read a Gameye agent skill bundled with this server: its SKILL.md, or one of its reference files. Works offline and serves only the bundled copy (list names and files with gameye_list_skills). If an installed copy of the Gameye skills is newer, it wins.

file.description: File inside the skill, e.g. references/routing.md. Defaults to SKILL.md

name.description: Skill name, e.g. gameye or gameye-containerize

name: gameye_get_skill
title: Read a bundled Gameye skill
